affected_party: QIF maintainers and organizations relying on agent recovery evidence
actual_problem: A fixed challenge set can repeatedly pass while missing novel, composed, or context-shifted weaknesses and can create false confidence without benign controls.
why_it_matters: A narrow corpus can make a declared recovery grade look robust while monitor evasions or excessive false alarms remain undiscovered.
why_now: QIF v0.8.20 introduced controlled challenges, and current 2026 research has moved toward adaptive, diverse, holdout-based red teaming with false-positive controls.
